findings.title: Templates audit row understates the current markup
findings.where: Per-Page Responsive Audit -> Templates list row
findings.problem: The real templates/page.tsx action cluster is `flex items-center space-x-3` (not space-x-4) and the left info cluster is `flex items-start space-x-4 flex-1` (not `flex items-center space-x-4`). The design's fix direction (space-x-* -> flex-wrap gap-2, header row -> flex-col sm:flex-row) still covers these, but the stated current classes are slightly off.
findings.fix: Note the templates action cluster is specifically space-x-3 and the left cluster is `flex items-start space-x-4 flex-1`; apply the same flex-wrap/gap-2 conversion to the space-x-3 cluster. No change to the intended outcome.

findings.title: scratchpad.md still claims /privacy-policy exists
findings.where: scratchpad.md (project doc), relevant to design Finding 1 reconciliation
findings.problem: scratchpad.md lists /privacy-policy as a static server-rendered page, but no such route exists under src/app (verified via file_search and grep: only Link references in login/register). The design correctly treats the route as dead and links the Footer only to /docs.
findings.fix: When implementing, update scratchpad.md to reflect that /privacy-policy is referenced but not implemented, and log the Footer/docs change. Does not block the design.
